name: Shougai Nenshuu Kateru Wake nai Tensai Koyaku Gouhou Shota ni Asoko no Saizu sura Makete Seishin Houkai Suru Novel Game
original_name: 生涯年収勝てるわけない天才子役合法ショタにアソコのサイズすら負けて精神崩壊するノベルゲーム
source:
Luna Inaba, a child acting prodigy, is a remarkably versatile talent—something you’d never guess just by looking at his cute face.
Rumors are even circulating that he’s “on a whole other level”—as if he’s been reincarnated.
But it’s no wonder: Luna Inaba’s actual age is 24! Amazingly, he’s been lying about his age by more than 10 years compared to what his agency has publicly stated!
You (his manager) are one of the few people who know Luna’s secret. To prevent a scandal from ruining the agency, you’re once again warning him today about his bad behavior…
translation:
稻叶露娜 (Luna Inaba) 是一位表演神童，是一位非常多才多艺的天才——这一点你永远无法仅通过看他可爱的脸来猜到。
甚至有传言称他“处于另一个层面”——就好像他已经转世一样。
但这也不足为奇：Luna Inaba的实际年龄是24岁！令人惊讶的是，与他的经纪公司公开的年龄相比，他谎报的年龄足足有十多年！
你（他的经理）是少数知道卢娜秘密的人之一。为了防止丑闻毁掉该机构，你今天再次警告他有关他的不良行为……
